6673125.name: Chabad of Trois-Rivières
6673125.note: Chabad.org on CrownHeights.info, 29 Nov 2024: 'Rabbi Aaron and Amanda Spiro, natives of Montreal, have officially established Chabad-Lubavitch of Trois-Rivières'. Lubavitch.com, 24 Dec 2024: from 2021 they had been visiting the city once a month for Shabbat and holiday programmes. Its chabad.org listing went up 9 Dec 2024.

3827161.name: Chabad Hope Center / The Family Store
3827161.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 2 May 2017 ('The Family Store Helps Keep Kosher Food Affordable'): Rabbi Yossi Kessler, 'who founded and directs the store with Rabbi Itchy Treitel': 'Nine years ago, we opened the store'. Medium: counted back (about 2008); this listing only went up in 2017.
